_about: This repository's exceptions to Tools/offboard/offboard.json: headers that aren't off-board headers though their name says so (not_offboard_refs), and off-board headers accepted on another connector, with the reason (connector_accepted).

not_offboard_refs.DEV|DEV Output Board|J1: AUDIO: the board's only audio output, to a speaker. It doesn't stand in for a part on the board.

connector_accepted.DEV|DEV Board|J3: Four buttons share one 2×4 header, drawn before the JST XH standard. DEV Board 1.1 keeps it as it is (owner, 2026-11-07; KICAD.md K12).
